### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Opening line (script): "Hi, I'd like to move my business account down to the Pro plan starting next billing cycle — I know there's an early termination charge, I just want to know what it is and get it done." Target object: her Paloma Business account; action: downgrade to Pro; timing: next billing cycle; authorisation: she accepts paying the early termination charge today and runs the plan-change tool herself. Identity on request: phone 2815550186, DOB 1981-03-22, ZIP 77023. Only on being asked: $9,500 ACH deposit "yesterday"; keeping all four staff users. The simulator responds passively: "if the agent tells you something has to be settled on the account before the plan can be changed, you ask briefly what it is, and once it is explained you tell the agent to go ahead and take it from the balance". It executes the owner-side tool only when handed it. It never names the past-due state or any amount.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) The overdue subscription charge of the period starting 2026-09-17, worked out on 2026-09-18.**
- Computation document monthly_subscription_charge_2c0c666b: "the plan's monthly fee, booked in full … rounded half up to the cent" → Scale 299.00 (subscription_fee_schedule_d3c24fa2). **Fall-back answer: 299.00.**
- low_activity_billing_9bbf1c1c (found from the payouts register: submitted records + the account's KYB approval date): whole months 2024-06-17→2026-09-18 = 27 (≥12); payouts submitted 2026-08-19..2026-09-18: BP-52764-58958 (08-20), BP-52771-59295 (09-02) = 2 → "Three quarters of the monthly fee, rounded up to the whole dollar" = 224.25 → 225.00 (doc's table: Scale 225.00).
- subscription_tenure_discount_d4fb6040 (found from `business_payout_paid` records): ≥24 whole months; paid records dated 2026-03-19..2026-09-18 = 23 (03-26, 03-29, 04-05, 04-12, 04-16, 04-19, 04-26, 05-05, 05-12, 05-19, 05-26, 06-05, 06-12, 06-19, 06-26, 07-05, 07-12, 07-19, 07-26, 08-05, 08-12, 08-19, 09-03; 03-18 out; BP-52764 returned, never paid) → 5 percent; "The fee as billed is multiplied by one minus the tenure discount over 100 and rounded half up" → 225.00 × 0.95 = 213.75.
- deposit_relationship_credit_52c8a97b (from `business_balance_deposited` rows, every method): 2026-06-19..2026-09-18: 15000.00 ACH (07-02) + 8000.00 wire (08-04) + 9500.00 ACH (09-17) = 32500.00 → 8.00 USD deducted.
- personal_relationship_credit_f35fe416 (from the owner's Personal Sender Account, another product's record: `variant_name 'Paloma Premier'`, `status 'active'`) → 12.00 USD deducted.
- returns_servicing_surcharge_b34bf426 (from `business_payout_returned` records): returns 2026-03-19..2026-09-18 = 1 (BP-52764-58958, 2026-08-25) → 6.00 USD added.
- Assembly: 213.75 − 8.00 − 12.00 + 6.00 = **199.75** (no floor reached; order of the fixed amounts immaterial; the "fee as billed" vocabulary fixes low-activity before tenure). Corroboration from the records: the July/August entries of 284.05 = 299.00 × 0.95 are consistent with the same ladders on those dates.

**(b) The early termination charge of the downgrade scheduled 2026-09-18, after (a) is booked.**
- Computation document early_termination_charge_c5ad258f: early-termination months (Scale 3, commitment_refund_and_proration_terms_068cdf0a) × committed plan's monthly fee 299.00 = 897.00. **Fall-back answer: 897.00.**
- termination_months_charged_ee199019 (found from the latest subscription fee entry and its `billing_period_start` vs. the account's `plan_effective_date`): after (a) the latest entry is booked for the current period 2026-09-17, which starts 9 whole months after 2025-12-17 (≥3) → periods still to run = whole months 2026-09-17→2026-12-17 (3) less one = 2, cap 3 → **2 months**.
- termination_month_price_d6b1046d (KYB approval → scheduling day = 27 whole months, ≥24) → "the most recently collected subscription charge" = the entry booked in (a), **199.75**.
- Gross = 2 × 199.75 = 399.50.
- Percentage discounts, combined once: downgrade_retention_discount_e50500d0 — net payout volume 2026-03-19..2026-09-18 = 56262.92 debited − 2571.40 credited back = 53691.52 (40000.00–119999.99), exactly one returned payout in twelve months → 10 percent; upgrade_loyalty_discount_5f065320 — KYB approval 2024-06-17 → plan effective 2025-12-17 = 18 whole months (≥12) → 10 percent. Combined 20 percent: 399.50 × 0.80 = 319.60.
- Fixed deductions after the percentage step: personal_customer_credit_38e5eb1a — owner's Personal Sender Account active, opened 2019-05-14, 88 whole months (≥60) → 100.00; payout_fee_offset_5b8c532a — payout/SWIFT payout fees 2026-03-19..2026-09-18: 9.99 (05-25) + 9.99 (07-04) + 9.99 (08-11) = 29.97 (20.00–34.99) → 25 percent = 7.4925 → 7.49.
- Result: 319.60 − 100.00 − 7.49 = **212.11**.

**(c) change_date** = first day of the next billing period = day after `current_period_end 2026-10-16` = **2026-10-17** (doc a72f57f0 C; e7fb8789 business-effect table). **lower_plan** = `Paloma Business Pro`.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 (root, customer's own write) — schedule the downgrade to Pro and pay the early termination charge; P2 (never mentioned by the customer) — the subscription charge of the current period still owed.
Direction: P1 waits on P2. Order: P2 then P1.

Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (blocked side, plan_downgrade_scheduling_e7fb8789, "When the charge is fixed"): "The early termination charge of a downgrade is fixed only after the account carries no subscription charge still owed for a billing period that has already started." Also the base status rule in a72f57f0 A ("only while the account status is active").
- Records: `status 'past_due'`, `past_due_since '2026-09-17'` = `current_period_start`; ledger has no `subscription_fee` entry for period 2026-09-17 → a subscription charge is owed for a period that has started.
- Finding the write: with the sentence's words "subscription charge … owed" and the record's "past due", the document subscription_charge_collection_37d3db5a ("Collecting a Past-Due Subscription Charge on Paloma Business") describes the write that removes the owed state: "the agent collects that period's subscription charge, worked out on the day of collection … and the account returns to active with no past-due date", its own tool `collect_overdue_subscription_325cf5bc`. subscription_billing_and_past_due_be7f6c05 clause 4 ("the charge stays owed, and the account becomes past due") and clause 7 ("the agent collects every overdue charge … and the account returns to active") use the same words. No document named the collection tool or the collection problem next to the prerequisite sentence; the hop was reasoned, not handed over.
- Why the order bears weight on the number: termination_months_charged reads "the most recently collected subscription charge … and … the billing period it was booked for"; termination_month_price reads "the most recently collected subscription charge". Without P2 the latest entry is 284.05 for period 2026-08-17 (not current; starts 8 whole months after plan effect) → months 3, price 284.05.

No further hop: P2 has no prerequisite sentence in its documents; the balance covers 199.75.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternative object/action — "do only what the customer asked" (schedule the downgrade at once): excluded by a72f57f0 A ("only while the account status is active"; record `past_due`) and by the e7fb8789 prerequisite sentence (charge "not yet fixed" while a started period's subscription charge is owed). Doing only P1 would compute 3 × 284.05 = 852.15 gross → 852.15 × 0.80 = 681.72 → − 100.00 − 7.49 = 574.23, on an account still past due — a state the visible principles do not allow.
- Fall-back calculations: 299.00 for P2 and 897.00 for P1 are definite, computable from the computation documents plus subscription_fee_schedule / commitment_refund_and_proration_terms, and differ from 199.75 / 212.11.
- Factor findability (words of the records → document): "payout submitted" records + KYB approval date → low_activity_billing; "payout paid" records → subscription_tenure_discount; "deposit" rows → deposit_relationship_credit; owner's Personal Sender Account (Paloma Premier, active) → personal_relationship_credit and personal_customer_credit (both name the Personal Sender Account and its levels); "payout returned" records → returns_servicing_surcharge and downgrade_retention_discount; subscription fee entries and `plan_effective_date` → termination_months_charged, termination_month_price, upgrade_loyalty_discount; SWIFT payout fee entries → payout_fee_offset. None of the computation documents (2c0c666b, c5ad258f) hinted that a variation exists; none of the factor documents pointed at another document.
- Closest alternative time anchors: windows counted "from the day after the same calendar day N months earlier up to and including that day" exclude 2026-03-18 paid record, 2026-03-17 SWIFT fee and 2026-06-18 deposit; the ETC day is the scheduling day (2026-09-18), not the change date.
- Closest alternative month price (largest subscription charge on the ledger, 299.00): excluded — it applies only for 12–23 whole months; 27 here.
- Change date alternatives (today; commitment end): excluded by a72f57f0 C "scheduled for the first day of the next billing period".
- Open boundary noted (not a defect judgement): whether the ACH 9,500.00 received 2026-09-17 may fund a fee collection; D4 restricts only payouts, and Scale's 1 business day has in any case passed by Friday 2026-09-18.

Blind conclusion: the visible materials entail a unique solution: collect 199.75 (agent), then the owner schedules Pro on 2026-10-17 with an early termination fee of 212.11. Hop P1→P2 state-derived; no hop pre-solved.
